written.name: round 1 rival 1
written.comment: Robin keeps hidden goodwill points: insult subtracts 2, apology/gift add 1; warm if points are at least 1.

written.name: round 1 rival 2
written.comment: Robin compares totals: warm only when apologies outnumber insults; gifts have no effect.

written.name: round 1 rival 3
written.comment: Robin uses first impression plus a grudge rule: warm iff first action is apologise and no insult directly follows another.

written.name: round 1 rival 4
written.comment: Robin tracks an apology, a permanent grudge from two insults in a row, and rejects ending on an insult.

written.name: round 2 rival 1
written.comment: Robin is warm only when there are no two insults in a row and, if there was an insult, an apology comes after the last insult.

written.name: round 2 rival 2
written.comment: Robin is warm when 2 times apologies plus gifts minus 2 times insults is positive.

written.name: round 2 rival 3
written.comment: Robin is warm when apologies plus gifts minus insults is positive.

written.name: round 2 rival 4
written.comment: If Robin starts with an apology, warmth only survives when no two insults are adjacent; if Robin starts with an insult, Robin warms only when not ending on an insult and either 3+ gifts or 2+ apologies occur.

written.name: round 3 rival 1
written.comment: Warm iff, after deleting gifts, there are no adjacent insults and every insult has a later apology.

written.name: round 3 rival 2
written.comment: Warm as in Rival 1, except a double insult is forgiven when at least three gifts follow the last insult and an apology comes after it.

written.name: round 3 rival 3
written.comment: Warm iff no adjacent insults and either an apology follows the last insult or at least five gifts follow the last insult.

written.name: round 3 rival 4
written.comment: Warm iff no adjacent insults and either an apology follows the last insult or two consecutive gifts follow the last insult.

survivors.name: round 3 rival 1
survivors.comment: Warm iff, after deleting gifts, there are no adjacent insults and every insult has a later apology.

shown the survivors.comment: Warm iff, after ignoring gifts, the remaining insults/apologies have no consecutive insults and do not end with an insult.

shown the facts only.comment: Robin is warm exactly when no insult is left unapologised; insults add grudges, apologies remove one, gifts do nothing.
